detail.title: Ensemble de manipulation robotisé
detail.abstract: Robotized handling assembly for handling objects (100), comprising an automated handling head (11) connected to an attachment mandrel (12) and provided with a jaw unit (13) that has at least two opposite handling jaws (14, 15), each of which is equipped with at least one lever (16) which can be driven pneumatically in rotation, and suction gripping members (22). The handling head (11) also comprises movement means (17) configured to selectively move said handling jaws (14, 15) with respect to each other.
